rejected.title: Protecting landscapes at different scales
card: Local
A local council can protect landscapes in its area. It may set aside a bushland reserve, look after a beach or limit building near a creek.
National
A country can protect landscapes through national parks. In New South Wales, a national park is set aside by the state government to protect its natural and cultural features.
Global

A place of great value to all people can be given World Heritage listing. The listing is made by the United Nations body UNESCO. The Blue Mountains and the Great Barrier Reef are listed places in Australia.
One landscape can be protected at more than one scale at once. The Blue Mountains are national parks and also a World Heritage area. A listing adds protection. It does not replace the national park.
rejected.remember: Councils protect locally, national parks nationally and World Heritage globally, and one place can have more than one.

a.q: A council sets aside a small bushland reserve beside a creek in its suburb. Who is protecting it, and at what scale?
opts: A council, at the local scale
A state government, at the national scale
A council, at the national scale
a.why: A council looks after its own area, so this is protection at the local scale. A council reserve is not a national park, so it is not national protection, even though it is a protected area.
a.clue: Think about how large an area a council looks after.

b.q: A rainforest in a New South Wales national park is later judged by UNESCO to be of great value to all people. At what scales is it now protected?
b.why: The national park protects it at the national scale, and UNESCO's decision gives it World Heritage listing at the global scale. Global only is tempting, but a listing adds protection and does not replace the national park.
b.clue: Does the national park disappear when UNESCO acts?

draft.title: Protecting landscapes at different scales
card: Local
A local council can protect landscapes in its area. It may set aside a bushland reserve, look after a beach or limit building near a creek.
National
A country can protect landscapes through national parks. In New South Wales, a national park is set aside by the state government to protect its natural and cultural features.
Global

A place of great value to all people can be given World Heritage listing. The listing is made by the United Nations body UNESCO. The Blue Mountains and the Great Barrier Reef are listed places in Australia.
Protection can work at more than one scale. A landscape can be a local reserve, part of a national park or a World Heritage area, depending on how far its value reaches.
draft.remember: Councils protect local landscapes, national parks protect landscapes for a country, and World Heritage listing protects landscapes of value to the world.

a.q: A council sets aside a small bushland reserve beside a creek in its suburb. At what scale is this landscape being protected?
a.why: The council is protecting a small area within its own suburb, so the scale is local. National protection would be through a national park, and global protection would be World Heritage listing.
a.clue: Think about who is looking after the reserve.

b.q: A coastal rainforest is valued by people around the world, and UNESCO adds it to a list so that it is protected for everyone. Which kind of protection is this?
b.why: UNESCO listing a place because it is valued by people around the world is World Heritage listing, which works at the global scale. A national park is tempting, but it is set aside by a government for its own country, not by UNESCO.
b.clue: Which group named in the question is not a council or a country?

problems.detail: The stem says UNESCO 'adds it to a list', which echoes the right option 'World Heritage listing'. A student could match the words without knowing the idea.

The last line says a landscape can be a local reserve, part of a national park 'or' a World Heritage area, 'depending on how far its value reaches'. This suggests each place has only one level, yet the line opens by saying protection works at more than one scale, and the Blue Mountains are both national parks and a World Heritage area.
